say:1:1530130601:0.text: Yes... all because of the war.
say:1:1530130601:0.source_cn: 是啊……全是因为这场战争。
say:1:1530130601:0.male: Yes... all because of the war.
say:1:1530130601:0.female: Yes... all because of the war.

say:2:1530130602:0.text: Many warriors have fallen, and their families wish to lay flowers at the trees where they're buried.
say:2:1530130602:0.source_cn: 很多战士死在了战场上，他们的亲人都想用花装点在埋葬他们...
say:2:1530130602:0.male: Many warriors have fallen, and their families wish to lay flowers at the trees where they're buried.
say:2:1530130602:0.female: Many warriors have fallen, and their families wish to lay flowers at the trees where they're buried.

say:3:1530130603:0.text: I'll keep a few myself... for my friends.
say:3:1530130603:0.source_cn: 我……我自己也要留一些，给我的朋友。
say:3:1530130603:0.male: I'll keep a few myself... for my friends.
